title: Verify mechanical criteria and slide integrity
description:
## Objective
Confirm nothing was orphaned and 01.3's surface is clean.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-diagram-verify/2026-08-13-diagram-verify-spec.md` — Sections 3-4

## Implementation
1. `grep -rn 'DIAGRAM-PLACEHOLDER' slides/` must return nothing.
2. `grep -rnE 'v-click|^layout:|^transition:|classDef|style ' slides/pages/` must return nothing.
3. `cd slides && npm run slides` reports 19.
4. Re-read slides 4, 10 and 14 in full. The 01.1 narrative must still make sense with the stand-in gone.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` then `cd slides && npm run slides`.
acceptance_criteria: no placeholders remain; no 01.3 features present; count 19; slides read correctly
